text_en: Now Abraham was old, well advanced in years; and the Lord had blessed Abraham in all things.
text_cn: 亚巴郎年纪已老，上主在一切事上常祝福他。

text_en: Abraham said to his servant, the oldest of his house, who had charge of all that he had, “Put your hand under my thigh
text_cn: 亚巴郎对管理他所有家产的老仆人说：“请你将手放在我的胯下，

text_en: and I will make you swear by the Lord , the God of heaven and earth, that you will not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live,
text_cn: 要你指着上主、天地的天主起誓：你决不要为我的儿子，由我现住的客纳罕人中，娶一个女子为妻；

text_en: but will go to my country and to my kindred and get a wife for my son Isaac. ”
text_cn: 却要到我的故乡，我的亲族中去，为我的儿子依撒格娶妻。”

text_en: The servant said to him, “Perhaps the woman may not be willing to follow me to this land; must I then take your son back to the land from which you came? ”
text_cn: 仆人对他说：“假使那女子不愿跟我到此地来，我能否带你的儿子回到你的本乡？”

text_en: Abraham said to him, “See to it that you do not take my son back there.
text_cn: 亚巴郎答复他说：“你切不可带我的儿子回到那里去。

text_en: The Lord , the God of heaven, who took me from my father’s house and from the land of my birth, and who spoke to me and swore to me, ‘To your offspring I will give this land, ’ he will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.
text_cn: 那引我出离父家和我生身地，同我谈过话，对我起誓说‘我必将这地赐给你后裔’的上主，上天的天主，必派遣自己的使者作你的前导，领你由那里给我儿子娶个妻子。

text_en: But if the woman is not willing to follow you, then you will be free from this oath of mine; only you must not take my son back there. ”
text_cn: 设若那女子不愿跟你来，你对我起的誓，就与你无涉；无论如何，你不能带我的儿子回到那里去。”

text_en: So the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master and swore to him concerning this matter.
text_cn: 仆人遂将手放在主人亚巴郎的胯下，为这事向他起了誓。

text_en: Then the servant took ten of his master’s camels and departed, taking all kinds of choice gifts from his master; and he set out and went to Aram-naharaim, to the city of Nahor.
text_cn: 仆人就由他主人的骆驼中，牵了十匹骆驼，带着主人的各样宝物，起身往美索不达米亚的纳曷尔城去了。

text_en: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water; it was toward evening, the time when women go out to draw water.
text_cn: 傍晚，女人们出来打水的时候，他叫骆驼卧在城外的水井旁，

text_en: And he said, “O Lord , God of my master Abraham, please grant me success today and show steadfast love to my master Abraham.
text_cn: 然后说：“上主、我主人亚巴郎的天主！求你对我主人亚巴郎施行仁慈，今日使我幸运。

text_en: I am standing here by the spring of water, and the daughters of the townspeople are coming out to draw water.
text_cn: 看我站在水泉旁，此时城中的女子正出来打水。

text_en: Let the girl to whom I shall say, ‘Please offer your jar that I may drink, ’ and who shall say, ‘Drink, and I will water your camels’—let her be the one whom you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I shall know that you have shown steadfast love to my master. ”
text_cn: 我对那个少女说：请你放下水罐，让我喝点水。如果她答说：请喝！并且我还要打水给你的骆驼喝，她即是你为你的仆人依撒格预定的少女；由此我知道，你对我主人施行了仁慈。”

text_en: Before he had finished speaking, there was Rebekah, who was born to Bethuel son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, coming out with her water jar on her shoulder.
text_cn: 话还没有说完，黎贝加就肩着水罐出来了。她是亚巴郎的兄弟纳曷尔的妻子米耳加的儿子贝突耳的女儿。

text_en: The girl was very fair to look upon, a virgin, whom no man had known. She went down to the spring, filled her jar, and came up.
text_cn: 这少女容貌很美，是个还没有人认识的处女。她下到水泉，灌满了水罐，就上来了。

text_en: Then the servant ran to meet her and said, “Please let me sip a little water from your jar. ”
text_cn: 仆人就跑上前去迎着她说：“请让我喝点你水罐里的水，好吗！”

text_en: “Drink, my lord, ” she said, and quickly lowered her jar upon her hand and gave him a drink.
text_cn: 她回答说：“先生！请喝！”她急忙将水罐放低，托在手上让他喝。

text_en: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will draw for your camels also, until they have finished drinking. ”
text_cn: 他喝足了以后，少女说：“我再为你的骆驼打水，叫它们也喝足。”

text_en: So she quickly emptied her jar into the trough and ran again to the well to draw, and she drew for all his camels.
text_cn: 遂急忙将罐里的水倒在槽里，再跑到那井里去打水，打水给他的骆驼喝。

text_en: The man gazed at her in silence to learn whether or not the Lord had made his journey successful.
text_cn: 仆人在旁静静地注视她，急愿知道，是否上主已使他此行成功。

text_en: When the camels had finished drinking, the man took a gold nose-ring weighing a half shekel, and two bracelets for her arms weighing ten gold shekels,
text_cn: 骆驼喝完了水以后，老人就拿出一个半‘协刻耳’重的金鼻环，和一对重十‘协刻耳’的金手镯，给她戴上，

text_en: and said, “Tell me whose daughter you are. Is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night? ”
text_cn: 然后说：“请你告诉我你是谁的女儿？你父亲家里，有没有地方可让我们过宿？”

text_en: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor. ”
text_cn: 她回答说：“我是米耳加给纳曷尔所生之子贝突耳的女儿。”

text_en: She added, “We have plenty of straw and fodder and a place to spend the night. ”
text_cn: 她又继续说：“我们家里有很多草料和饲粮，而且还有地方可供过宿。”

text_en: The man bowed his head and worshiped the Lord
text_cn: 老人就俯身朝拜了上主，说：

text_en: and said, “Blessed be the Lord , the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his steadfast love and his faithfulness toward my master. As for me, the Lord has led me on the way to the house of my master’s kin. ”
text_cn: “上主，我主人亚巴郎的天主应受赞美！因为他不断以仁慈和忠信善待了我的主人。上主也一路引我来到了我主人的老家。”

text_en: Then the girl ran and told her mother’s household about these things.
text_cn: 那少女跑回去，将这一切事告诉了她母亲家中的人。

text_en: Rebekah had a brother whose name was Laban; and Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.
text_cn: 黎贝加有个哥哥名叫拉班，他一看见他妹妹鼻上的金环，和手腕上的金镯，听见他妹妹黎贝加说：“那人如此如此对我说。”

text_en: As soon as he had seen the nose-ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s arms, and when he heard the words of his sister Rebekah, “Thus the man spoke to me, ” he went to the man; and there he was, standing by the camels at the spring.
text_cn: 拉班就跑去见那在郊外水泉旁的人，迨(dài)他来到那人那里，见他仍站在靠近水泉的骆驼旁，

text_en: He said, “Come in, O blessed of the Lord . Why do you stand outside when I have prepared the house and a place for the camels? ”
text_cn: 就对他说：“你这受上主祝福的人，请来！我已预备好了房屋和喂骆驼的地方；你为什么还站在郊外？”

text_en: So the man came into the house; and Laban unloaded the camels, and gave him straw and fodder for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.
text_cn: 拉班便将那人领进家去，卸了骆驼，喂上草料和饲粮；又拿水给他和与他同来的人洗脚，

text_en: Then food was set before him to eat; but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my errand. ” He said, “Speak on. ”
text_cn: 然后在他面前摆上饭，但仆人却说：“在我未说明我的来意之前，我不吃饭。”拉班说：“你说吧！”

text_en: So he said, “I am Abraham’s servant.
text_cn: 他说：“我是亚巴郎的仆人，

text_en: The Lord has greatly blessed my master, and he has become wealthy; he has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male and female slaves, camels and donkeys.
text_cn: 上主厚厚地祝福了我的主人，使他十分富有，赐了他羊群、牛群、金银、仆婢、骆驼和驴子。

text_en: And Sarah my master’s wife bore a son to my master when she was old; and he has given him all that he has.
text_cn: 我主人的妻子撒辣，在老年给我主人生了一个儿子，主人遂将所有的财产都给了他。

text_en: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live;
text_cn: 我主人叫我起誓说：你决不要给我的儿子，由我现居地的客纳罕人中，娶一个女子为妻。

text_en: but you shall go to my father’s house, to my kindred, and get a wife for my son. ’
text_cn: 你该到我的父家和我的同族中，为我儿子娶妻。

text_en: I said to my master, ‘Perhaps the woman will not follow me. ’
text_cn: 我对我主人说：假使女儿不愿跟我来怎么办？

text_en: But he said to me, ‘The Lord , before whom I walk, will send his angel with you and make your way successful. You shall get a wife for my son from my kindred, from my father’s house.
text_cn: 他回答我说：我一向在上主面前行走，他必派遣自己的使者与你同行，使你此行必成功，能由我的同族，我的父家，为我儿子娶妻。

text_en: Then you will be free from my oath, when you come to my kindred; even if they will not give her to you, you will be free from my oath. ’
text_cn: 只要你去了我同族那里，你就履行了对我起的誓；若是他们不给你，你对我起的誓，就与你无涉。

text_en: “I came today to the spring, and said, ‘O Lord , the God of my master Abraham, if now you will only make successful the way I am going!
text_cn: 今天我到了水泉那里就说：上主，我主人亚巴郎的天主！惟愿你使我此行成功。

text_en: I am standing here by the spring of water; let the young woman who comes out to draw, to whom I shall say, “Please give me a little water from your jar to drink, ”
text_cn: 看我现在站在泉旁，我对那个出来打水的少女说：请你让我喝点你水罐里的水吧！

text_en: and who will say to me, “Drink, and I will draw for your camels also”—let her be the woman whom the Lord has appointed for my master’s son. ’
text_cn: 如果她对我说：请喝，并且我还要打水给你的骆驼喝，她即是上主为我主人的儿子预定的妻子。

text_en: “Before I had finished speaking in my heart, there was Rebekah coming out with her water jar on her shoulder; and she went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink. ’
text_cn: 我心里尚未说完这话，看，黎贝加肩着水罐来了，下到水泉那里打水，我就对她说：请给我一点水喝！

text_en: She quickly let down her jar from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also water your camels. ’ So I drank, and she also watered the camels.
text_cn: 她急忙从肩上放下水罐说：你喝，并且我还要打水给你的骆驼喝。我喝了，同时她也给了骆驼水喝。

text_en: Then I asked her, ‘Whose daughter are you? ’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him. ’ So I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her arms.
text_cn: 我于是问她说：你是谁的女儿？她答说：我是米耳加给纳曷尔生的儿子贝突耳的女儿。我就将鼻环戴在她鼻上，将手镯带在她手腕上。

text_en: Then I bowed my head and worshiped the Lord , and blessed the Lord , the God of my master Abraham, who had led me by the right way to obtain the daughter of my master’s kinsman for his son.
text_cn: 然后我俯身朝拜了上主，赞颂了上主、我主人亚巴郎的天主，因为他引我走了正路，为我主人的儿子娶了我主人兄弟的孙女。

text_en: Now then, if you will deal loyally and truly with my master, tell me; and if not, tell me, so that I may turn either to the right hand or to the left. ”
text_cn: 现在，如果你们愿意以仁慈和忠信善待我主人，请告诉我；如果不肯，也请告诉我；我好决定行事。”

text_en: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing comes from the Lord ; we cannot speak to you anything bad or good.
text_cn: 拉班和贝突耳答说：“这件事既是出于上主，我们不能对你说好说坏。

text_en: Look, Rebekah is before you, take her and go, and let her be the wife of your master’s son, as the Lord has spoken. ”
text_cn: 看黎贝加在你面前，你可带她去做你主人儿子的妻子，如上主所说的。”

text_en: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself to the ground before the Lord .
text_cn: 亚巴郎的仆人一听见他们说出这话，就俯伏在地朝拜了上主；

text_en: And the servant brought out jewelry of silver and of gold, and garments, and gave them to Rebekah; he also gave to her brother and to her mother costly ornaments.
text_cn: 然后拿出金银的珍饰和衣服来，送给了黎贝加，又送给了她的哥哥和她的母亲一些宝贵礼品。

text_en: Then he and the men who were with him ate and drank, and they spent the night there. When they rose in the morning, he said, “Send me back to my master. ”
text_cn: 这以后，他和同他前来的人才吃喝，并住了一宿。清早起来，他就说：“请让我回到我主人那里去！”

text_en: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the girl remain with us a while, at least ten days; after that she may go. ”
text_cn: 黎贝加的哥哥和母亲说：“让少女同我们再住上几天或十天，然后走吧！”

text_en: But he said to them, “Do not delay me, since the Lord has made my journey successful; let me go that I may go to my master. ”
text_cn: 他回答他们说：“你们不要挽留我，上主既使我此行成功，请你们让我走，回到我主人那里去。”

text_en: They said, “We will call the girl, and ask her. ”
text_cn: 他们说：“我们可叫少女来，问问她的意思。”

text_en: And they called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man? ” She said, “I will. ”
text_cn: 他们就将黎贝加叫来问她说：“你愿意跟这人去吗？”她答说：“愿意。”

text_en: So they sent away their sister Rebekah and her nurse along with Abraham’s servant and his men.
text_cn: 于是他们打发自己的姊妹黎贝加和她的乳母，同亚巴郎的仆人和与他同来的人一起走了。

text_en: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, “May you, our sister, become thousands of myriads; may your offspring gain possession of the gates of their foes. ”
text_cn: 他们祝福黎贝加说：“我们的妹妹，愿你子孙无数！愿你的后裔，占领仇敌的城门！”

text_en: Then Rebekah and her maids rose up, mounted the camels, and followed the man; thus the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
text_cn: 黎贝加便和自己的婢女们起来，上了骆驼，跟那人去了。仆人便带着黎贝加起了程。

text_en: Now Isaac had come from Beer-lahai-roi, and was settled in the Negeb.
text_cn: 那时依撒格刚来到拉海洛依井旁附近，他原住在乃革布地方。

text_en: Isaac went out in the evening to walk in the field; and looking up, he saw camels coming.
text_cn: 傍晚时，依撒格出来在田间来回沉思，举目一望，看见了一队骆驼。

text_en: And Rebekah looked up, and when she saw Isaac, she slipped quickly from the camel,
text_cn: 黎贝加举目看见了依撒格，便由骆驼上下来，

text_en: and said to the servant, “Who is the man over there, walking in the field to meet us? ” The servant said, “It is my master. ” So she took her veil and covered herself.
text_cn: 问仆人说：“田间前来迎接我们的那人是谁？”仆人答说：“是我的主人。”黎贝加遂拿面纱蒙在脸上。

text_en: And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.
text_cn: 仆人就将自己所作的一切事，告诉了依撒格。

text_en: Then Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent. He took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
text_cn: 依撒格便领黎贝加进入自己母亲撒辣的帐幕，娶了她为妻，很是爱她。依撒格自从母亲死后，这才有了安慰。
